pose: The group of adult Pachycephalosaurus is shown with their backs turned, departing the scene. Approaching from the opposite side, the adult Dakotaraptor (REF_DAKOTASAURUS_ADULT) enters the clearing, cautiously but excitedly approaching the remaining Orodromeus remains. The Dakotaraptor is captured in the moment it begins feeding on a stylized chicken drumstick placed near the carcass. The Orodromeus carcass is now fully skeletonized, reduced strictly to the skull and ribcage bones, showing no remaining soft tissue.

render_parameters.negative_constraints: No graphic violence, strictly toy-like 'X' eye effect on skull, no text, no labels, no borders, no extraneous people or IDs, strictly two arms per dinosaur, no negative space
